name: zeus
description: Issue→code→PR→review workflow as one family. Aligns on work as GitHub issues (propose decision docs/RFCs, investigate evidence-driven inquiries), then surfaces the branch as a reviewer-friendly PR (create-pr) — which reviews the diff and verifies the linked issue's contract before opening — drives it to mergeable (address-pr), and hands off to a reviewer (request-review). review-pr is the shared read-only review engine, auto-detecting a local pre-PR diff or an open PR; improve retrospects on the family. Skills share durable facts via a per-worktree journey.json and invoke each other by name through JSON contracts.
